introduction: Visit Harrow's artists and craftspeople, return a lost ring, commission Alorka's creations and explore the village's stranger corners.
orientation: A young girl has lost the ring her father made. Ask her about lost, ring or sad, then search the gardens. Her thank-you token can pay for one of Alorka's crafts.
Ask Alorka about craft or list. Each creation needs a token and two more ingredients. Four creations mean four tokens; you can return on later visits or obtain materials from other adventurers.
Alorka offers a glass horn, a robe of many colors, a swirling wand of light and a lucky alchemist sack. Choose the ingredients for the creation you want.
Bom Fitherwood, by the lake, would like a painting for his cabin. Ask him about fish or trade. He wants the artists' near-finished painting and offers fish in return.
The unusual fishbowl leads to a world of its own. Bring fish food to a goldfish there, and remember where you entered.
A leprechaun has promised a lucky clover for a pot of gold. His home is secluded; the journal has no verified ordinary route to offer yet.
Carry the requested items loose in your inventory. An earlier quest reward can supply a later request, but you still need the actual item when you make the offering.
